roles.name: Owner
roles.where: In Bitrix24: the portal opens as the GetsEstate app in the left menu and as the Units tab in a deal. “Open full screen” shows the full portal. No separate password — you sign in through Bitrix24.
steps: Project terms
Admin → Terms: rates, discounts by down payment and term, reservation period, developer limit. Every change is a new version; existing deals keep their own.
Users and roles
Admin → Users: invite, change role and market, deactivate. “Sign out everywhere” ends all sessions on all devices.
Discounts above the limit
Requests from sales managers and partners arrive as a notification and a Bitrix24 task — approve or decline.
Payout register
Finance → monthly register: once markets have confirmed, click “Approve”. Only you can write off a partner’s debt.
Control
Log shows who changed what. “Log in as” shows the portal through a user’s eyes, read-only.
rules: Change terms before the first reservation on a project — otherwise it becomes a new version for future deals.
Internal developer terms and the discount pool are visible only to the owner, market heads and finance.
Client data deletion — Admin → deletion requests, within 30 days.
roles.help: Technical questions — in the GetsEstate team chat.

roles.name: Market head
roles.where: In Bitrix24: leads and deals of your market, the GetsEstate app in the left menu, the Units tab in a deal. Sign in through Bitrix24.
steps: New leads
Website leads are assigned by market, language and workload. Make sure first contact happens within the market’s deadline.
Partner applications
Partners → new application: check the agency or agent and grant access — the account opens automatically.
Discounts above the limit
When a sales manager or partner asks for more than their discount, you get a task. Approve within the market limit or decline with a reason.
“Whose client” disputes
The Ownership dispute flag in a deal — decide and record who owns the client.
Market money
Finance → monthly register: check your market’s accruals and confirm.
rules: A team client is attached immediately for 6 months.
A partner’s client starts as a candidate (30-day priority); attachment for 6 months comes after qualification.
A partner with no new qualified clients for 6 months becomes Inactive; access stays.
roles.help: Questions about terms — the owner; about reservations — the Baku office.

roles.name: Sales manager
roles.where: In Bitrix24: your leads and deals. Units, selections and reservations are in the Units tab of the deal card. Sign in through Bitrix24.
steps: First contact
Contact a new lead within the market’s deadline and record the result in Bitrix24.
Client consent
Send the client the consent link from the card — the client ticks the boxes. Without consent there is no developer registration and no contract.
Selection
Units → Selection: units from the availability grid or catalogue → “Add to selection”. The client gets a link in their language, without developer contacts.
Hold and reservation
A hold keeps a unit for 24 hours. Then “Request reservation” — the Baku office confirms it with the developer.
Discount
Within your limit — immediately. More — “Ask for more”; the market head decides.
KYC and contract
Request the buyer check. “Contract signed” is set by the Baku office only after KYC.
rules: A repeat hold on the same unit — no earlier than 24 hours later.
The reservation period depends on the project and is shown on the unit card.
Reserved, SPA signed and Won stages are set only by the portal.
roles.help: Reservation not confirmed — the Baku office; discount — the market head.

roles.name: Baku office
roles.where: In Bitrix24 (back-office tasks) and in the portal: reservations, registrations, KYC, sources. Sign in through Bitrix24.
steps: Reservations
Bookings → awaiting confirmation: reserve with the developer and click “Confirm” with the developer’s reservation number. Not possible — “Reject” with a reason.
Registrations
Registrations → daily batch: “File for developer (xlsx)”, send it and “Mark as sent”. The developer’s answer — confirmed or rejected.
KYC
Check the documents of the buyer and co-buyers. Without passed KYC a deal cannot move to “Contract signed”.
Contract
“Mark as signed”: contract number and a date no later than today in Baku time.
Properties and sources
Statuses and prices come from Profitbase. If they differ — Sources → sync.
rules: Confirm a reservation within one working day.
3 days before a reservation ends and on the last day you get a task: extend or release.
Developer reservation limit: above it — a queue of up to 7 days.
roles.help: Questions about terms — the owner or the market head.

roles.name: Finance
roles.where: In the portal: Finance, Plan vs actual, reservations with back-office rights. Sign in through Bitrix24.
steps: Incoming payments
Finance → developer tranches: when the money is in the account — “Yes, funds received” and the date received. Partner accruals appear only after that.
Client payments
Enter client payments for the deal — they drive the Installments and Won stages.
Payout register
Cut-off month → build the register, markets confirm, the owner approves, then “Paid in bank”.
Refunds
Termination: commission refund goes for approval. 3 months without offset — issue a refund invoice.
Developer debts
Debt older than 10 working days — on the watch list.
rules: Payouts under $100, without a statement or invoice, or with bank details changed less than 3 days ago — move to the next month.
Tax is withheld if there is no residence certificate.
Agent report for developers — monthly xlsx.
roles.help: Questions about payout terms — the owner.

roles.name: Content
roles.where: In the portal: news for partners, materials, templates. Sign in through Bitrix24.
steps: News
News for partners by market and language. When you save, the portal warns about forbidden words.
Materials
Presentations, photos, videos and plans — partners download them from “Materials”.
Templates
Document and message templates; the owner reviews changes.
Catalogue
Catalogue and availability grid — read-only, to check texts against availability.
rules: For Germany and Israel — no yields, no price growth, no residence permit for purchase, no “capital preservation”.
Only confirmed figures with a source and date.
BRABUS ads and presentations — after the developer’s approval.
roles.help: Unsure about wording — ask the market head.

roles.name: Agency head
roles.where: In the partner portal — in a browser on a computer or phone.
steps: Sign in
Apply on the website → after approval you get an email with a link: set your password (the link is valid for 7 days).
Staff
Staff → “Add a colleague”: name, email, language. Clients are attached to the agency; you see your staff’s clients and reservations.
Client
Clients → “New client” → consent link to the client. Fill in goal, budget, timing, country and language — then the client is attached to you for 6 months.
Selection and reservation
Units → “Add to selection” → link for the client under your agency brand. Hold for 24 hours → “Request reservation”.
Commission
Commission → monthly statement: check it, “I agree with the statement”, “Upload invoice”.
rules: Until qualified, a client is a candidate: 30-day priority without protection.
Payout — after the developer has paid GetsEstate its fee, in the same proportion.
Without agreeing to the statement or an invoice, the payout moves to the next month.
roles.help: Your market head — contact in your profile.

roles.name: Partner
roles.where: In the partner portal — in a browser on a computer or phone. If you work for an agency, your agency head invited you.
steps: Client
Clients → “New client” and the consent link: the client ticks the boxes. Registration is not possible without consent.
Qualification
Fill in goal, budget, timing, country and language — the client is attached to you for 6 months and we register them with developers.
Selection
Catalogue or availability grid → “Add to selection” → “Link for the client” in their language; you can send it via WhatsApp.
Hold and reservation
A hold keeps a unit for 24 hours. “Request reservation” — the Baku office confirms it with the developer; you get a notification.
Discount
Within your share — straight away in the calculator. More — “Ask for more”.
My links
A personal link to a page of units under your brand: enquiries from it come to you.
rules: If another partner already has the client, the portal says “already attached” — without the owner’s name.
The office runs the deal and payments; you see the stage.
Payout — after the developer pays; agency staff are paid through the agency head.
roles.help: Your market head — contact in your profile.

roles.name: Referrer
roles.where: In your “Referrals” account. Sign in with a one-time link from the email; no password needed.
steps: Refer
“Refer someone”: name, phone, country of residence and what they are looking for.
Consent
Confirm that the person knows about the referral and agrees to be contacted by GetsEstate.
Then it’s on us
A manager will contact the person. The status of each referral is in the list.
Reward
If the person buys a unit, the expected reward appears in your account.
rules: Refer only people who agree to a call.
Reward — after the purchase and the developer’s payment.
The sign-in link comes by email; request a new one on the sign-in page.
roles.help: Questions — reply to the GetsEstate email.
